name: Switch Partners
controls: Player 1 uses arrows and Enter. Player 2 uses WASD and Q.

players.controls: You are the blue player 1. Left and right arrows walk. Up jumps. Down stops. Enter holds or releases a nearby switch. Hold the left switch while your partner passes the gate, then cross while they hold the right switch. Both reach the exit.

You are the gold player 2. A and D walk. W jumps. S stops. Q holds or releases a nearby switch. Cross while your partner holds the left switch, then hold the right switch for them. Both reach the exit.

goal: Work together: one player holds the left switch while the other crosses the gate and holds the right switch. Then both cross and reach the green exit. A switch stays held until its player moves or uses it again. Test the controls and file any bugs you see.
